detail.overview: Intex LED-WOS6530U 65” Smart TV Experience the magic of 4K clarity with the Intex LED-WOS6530U 65” Smart TV, powered by webOS. With vibrant Ultra HD visuals, Dolby Audio, and a bottom-firing box speaker, your entertainment is louder, clearer, and smarter. It’s not just a TV, it’s your smart entertainment hub, seamlessly compatible with Apple AirPlay & Apple Home. From fast processing to screen mirroring, built-in Wi-Fi, and immersive connectivity, this frameless beauty is where tech meets theatre, right in your living room.

Screen Mirroring: ThinQ AI, TV Cast
